name: Thursday Boot
why: New York boot company from 2014, the Goodyear-welted Captain at under $200 with named tanneries and no sales, ever; five stores of its own, founder-owned.
origin: Founded in 2014 in New York, NY (Columbia Business School) by Nolan Walsh and Connor Wilson.

notes.craft: Thread proposed 3 (2026-10-11): Thursday names its mills and tanneries on product pages (Horween, Shinki, C.F. Stead, Halley Stevensons, Le Farc) and documents Goodyear welt construction, but names no maker. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.owned: Claim only: Our Story says "By investing in our own manufacturing facility, we work side by side with the people who make our products" but names no place; FAQ and Our Product list manufacturing partners in León (Mexico), Porto (Portugal), Alicante (Spain) and Arkansas (USA); founder interview says the company has staff in the León factory for QC
craft_evidence.makers: NONE (no product page names a factory or workshop; cities only on Our Product/FAQ)
craft_evidence.mills: yes, on product pages: Halley Stevensons waxed canvas (12 apparel handles); Horween (14), Shinki Hikaku cordovan (4), C.F. Stead (5), Seidel (2), Badalassi (1), Wickett & Craig (1) on footwear; Le Farc tannery on Our Product
craft_evidence.madein: apparel 18 of 177 handles (10%): Portugal 16, Turkey 2; footwear 0 of 314 men's records state a country on the page (site-level: León, Porto, Alicante, Arkansas)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated: founded 2014 by Nolan Walsh and Connor Wilson at Columbia Business School, New York (brand blog interview); site itself says "proud to be based in New York City"
craft_evidence.process: yes for footwear (Goodyear welt construction guide; León bootmaking page; Thursday Chrome tannage described); apparel: fabric weights and washes only
craft_evidence.reasoning: Thursday names its mills and tanneries on product pages (Horween, Shinki, C.F. Stead, Halley Stevensons, Le Farc) and documents Goodyear welt construction, but names no maker. Its "own manufacturing facility" is an unnamed claim, and production is placed only by city (León, Porto, Alicante, Arkansas) through partners. Apparel states a country on 10% of handles.

ownership.owner: Thursday Boot Company, private and founder-led; founders say they took no venture capital or private equity (brand blog interview; no filing read)

opview: “We don't play games with our customers in the form of sales and discounts.” — Nolan Walsh, co-founder, Thursday blog, "Thursday Boots from the Beginning to Now" (interview)
